title: Exhaustive tableau index cases
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T\in\mathbb N$. Every natural number $i<(T+1)\bigl(k(2T+1)+N+3\bigr)$ has at least one of the following forms: it indexes a work-tape cell at some time $t\le T$, for a tape $\tau$ and offset $r<2T+1$; it indexes an input position at some time $t\le T$, with position $p<N+2$; or it indexes a snapshot at some time $t\le T$.
hypotheses_covered: i<(T+1) times the tableau stride k(2T+1)+N+3
